item.title: Hezbollah: Helicopter infiltration sparked clashes with Israeli soldiers
item.description: Hezbollah: Helicopter infiltration sparked clashes with Israeli soldiers Hezbollah on Saturday said its fighters clashed with Israeli troops after what it described as a helicopter infiltration in eastern Lebanon’s Bekaa Valley, AFP reported. item.title: Dubai says debris fall caused minor incident
item.description: Dubai says debris fall caused minor incident Authorities in Dubai on Saturday said a “minor incident” occurred after debris fell following an interception, according to a statement from the Dubai Media Office. Officials said the situation was quickly contained and no injuries were reported. The statement denied social media reports claiming there had been an incident at Dubai International Airport, adding that operations in the area were unaffected.

item.title: Demonstrators rally in Sanaa in solidarity with Iran and Lebanon
item.description: Demonstrators rally in Sanaa in solidarity with Iran and Lebanon Demonstrators gathered in the capital, Sanaa, on Friday to express solidarity with Iran and Lebanon amid the escalating conflict with the United States and Israel. item.description: Missile waves from Iran send millions of Israelis to shelters overnight Millions of Israelis were forced into shelters overnight after Iran launched multiple waves of ballistic missiles toward the country, according to Al Jazeera, which reported that at least five missiles were detected since midnight, triggering air raid sirens across several areas. item.title: US works on exit options for citizens in Qatar
item.description: US works on exit options for citizens in Qatar The US Embassy in Qatar on Saturday urged American citizens in the region to remain vigilant as efforts continue to assist them in leaving the Middle East. In a notice, the embassy said it is working on additional options to help US nationals depart safely. Officials advised Americans to closely monitor their email for updates or last-minute changes related to travel arrangements.
